data.text/markdown:
Cricket starter: bat first or chase?

Data: Cricsheet - free ball-by-ball data for T20, ODI, and Test matches. Credit Cricsheet when you use it. The coin toss decides who bats first - but should you want to? Let's answer it with every Women's Premier League T20 ever played (about 370 KB of data; the men's IPL is one folder up on Cricsheet).

Teams chasing won 60% of these matches. So: win the toss, bowl first?

Your turn

  • Is the chase advantage bigger in some venues? info["venue"] is in every match.
  • Ball by ball: every delivery is in innings - who are the top run-scorers and wicket-takers?
  • The real question is par score: given the first-innings total, how often does the chase succeed? (That's the road to Duckworth-Lewis.)
